The unchanged observed Statement used d x/dt for a free vector without a defined velocity map. It now defines v(V)=c Vspatial/V0 for V0>0 and factors eta(V,V)=(V0)^2(|v|^2/c^2-1), proving both cone-membership directions and the null equality; zero is explicitly excluded from this map. The sound linearization, symmetrizer, characteristic, energy and formal growing-mode arguments are preserved. The direct physical response consumer already uses c sqrt(a_s)<=c and requires no repair.

It now defines v(V)=c Vspatial/V0 for V0>0 and factors the metric quadratic form, proving the cone comparison and null-boundary speed, with the zero-vector exception explicit. Independently checked the linearization, energy cancellation, five-dimensional symmetrizer, damping and characteristic polynomial. The example and physical response theorem use the same speed and hypotheses and need no repair.
